profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Samsung Ad, Samsung Electronics America
profile.summary:
* MS degreed professional with 3+ years of experience in mobile development, and over 7 years of experience in OOD & OOP.
* Extensive experience of full development life cycle from product concept through deployment, including agile process.
* Dedicated to excellence and passionate about developing high-quality software.
* Proactive and collaborative team player with strong sense of personal responsibility.
* Excellent problem solving and communication skills.
* Fluent in English and Chinese, comfortable in Japanese.
* US citizen

Published iOS App:
1. SchoolMessenger InfoCenter
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/schoolmessenger-infocenter/id978894818?mt=8
2. Various K-12 school district apps by "Custom School Apps", such as 
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shawnee-mission-school-district/id826711491?mt=8
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/boulder-valley-school-district/id980295092?mt=8
3. "Moo Moo from Bluu Cow"
4. "SharePractice" by Share Practice, Inc.
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sharepractice/id574653607?mt=8&ign-mpt=uo%3D4

OS:
iOS, Mac OS, Linux, Android, MS Windows, Embedded Systems

Languages & Frameworks:
Swift, Objective-C, C++, C, JavaScript, Java, Linux Shell Script, JSON, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Cocoa Touch

Development Tools: 
Xcode, Design pattern, git, JIRA, Salesforce, GNU tools, DeviceSpy, Wireshark, A/V Analyzer

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile Development
positions.description:
Worked on various communication and notification apps, including unit tests, for US K-12 education market on iOS and Android devices.  Product development is conducted in Agile scrum process.
* Native iOS apps: in Swift, Objective-C, APNS, Restful API, UIKit, etc.
* Migrated Objective-C app to Swift & Objective-C mixed app using interoperability and mix & match technology. 
* Hybrid mobile apps for iOS and Android devices: in JavaScript, SCSS, CSS, Backbone, Marionette, JQuery.
* Published apps:
  1. SchoolMessenger InfoCenter
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/schoolmessenger-infocenter/id978894818?mt=8
  2. Various school apps by "Custom School Apps", such as 
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shawnee-mission-school-district/id826711491?mt=8
    https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/boulder-valley-school-district/id980295092?mt=8

positions.title: Software Engineer – iOS Mobile
positions.description:
Created fun apps for iOS devices, in Objective-C and design patterns (MVC, Singleton).
* Location-awareness app - frameworks including Core Data, Core Location, Map Kit, Camera, Camera Roll, UIKit, etc.
* “Moo Moo from Bluu Cow” - animated sound matching app: in Objective-C, AVFoundation, Core Graphics, MessageUI, UIKit, etc.

positions.title: iOS Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed iPhones app enabling doctors to share practice experiences.  Development was conducted in Agile practice.
* Native iOS app: in Objective-C, Restful API, UIKit, Foundations, etc.
* Refactored the existing app into better architect and more maintainable product.
* iPhone app: “SharePractice”
  https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sharepractice/id574653607?mt=8&ign-mpt=uo%3D4

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Continued education in mobile development, and implemented iOS applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on various TV guide SDK and sample applications for Linux embedded system.
* TotalGuide - an enhanced and GUI TV guide application offering simple, centralized and intuitive access to multiple content types.  In C, C++, Java, XML, Web Kit, etc.
* Created sample programs and assisted customers to port Rovi DLNA stacks to their embedded platforms and products.
* Trouble shot customers’ problems, resolved bugs, and tracked records in JIRA and Salesforce.
* Recognized for volunteering to set up system for CES over major holiday.
* Recognized by customers for quick response time and fast resolution of problems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led engineers and developed yield enhancement systems for the Flat Panel Display productions and Solar Energy industry.
* Achievements: Cell Gap Measurement of liquid crystal, White Light Interferometer for 3D profilometry measurement, Print Inspection and Cell Classifier for solar energy, and Critical Dimension Measurement.  All were architected as distributed systems and OO designed.
* Analyzed, architected, and designed system in UML; developed GUI software application in Windows, Visual C++, C#, .Net Framework, and MS SQL Server.
* Complete development life cycle: from product concept, prototyping, requirement analysis, design, implementation, integration, regression test, through product deployment.
* Successfully drove development to completeness under time pressure and dynamic environment.  Communicated with customers and drew deliverable product specification; coordinated among SW, HW, optical, and automation teams for system integration.
* Established source control mechanism utilizing Visual Source Safe.
* Conducted technical guidance and training to sales team and customers.
